design_principles: Single parse, many consumers — one boundary-aware parser scans all 5 pack files once
Each stage adds a column, not a re-scan
Artifact versioning with pack-file hashes for staleness detection
Consolidate overlapping artifacts into unified outputs

canonical_artifact_chain.name: Canonical Question Index
canonical_artifact_chain.action: Single boundary-aware, string-aware, CC-offset-tolerant parser reads all 5 pack files once. Produces QID list + fundamental properties.

canonical_artifact_chain.name: Readiness Scoring + Gate Scan (merged)
canonical_artifact_chain.action: Consume canonical_question_index. Compute readiness states + gate-level defect flags in a single pass.

canonical_artifact_chain.name: Certification Candidate Engine
canonical_artifact_chain.action: Consume readiness_scoring.json. Filter by state/defect. Add identity validation. NO re-scan of pack files.
canonical_artifact_chain.eliminates: All QID re-discovery. Eliminates DL-036 regex divergence.

canonical_artifact_chain.name: Derived Consumers
canonical_artifact_chain.action: All consume from stages 2-3. ZERO pack file access.
canonical_artifact_chain.eliminates: All duplicate QID extraction in remediation, wave planning, routing, and work queue tools
